credits.title: Bitter Christmas
credits.overview: During a long December holiday weekend, a woman, whose mother has recently died, throws herself into work as a form of escape. Her relentless pace is interrupted when a panic attack forces her to take a break.

credits.overview: In a future society where only happiness and unqualified admiration for beauty are permitted, a man devotes himself to producing the elixir of youth: tears. Crying is forbidden, and he finds himself hunted down by a doctor, the forces of the state and even his own wife.imdb

credits.title: What Happens In Cap Vermell
credits.overview: What Happens In Cap Vermell is a story of love and heartbreak, of human relationships, of chance encounters and exceptional characters. A succession of moments linked together that all occur in one place, Cap Vermell, a heavenly, incomparable backdrop where anything can happen.
